source.text: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֖ם שְׁכֶ֑ם כִּ֥י שְׁכֶ֛ם בָּ֥א כָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְהַמְלִ֥יךְ אֹתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And went Rehoboam [to] Shechem, for [to] Shechem had come all Israel to make king him.

en.L: And Rehoboam went [to] Shechem, for all Israel had come [to] Shechem to make him king.
en.B: Rehoboam went to Shechem, because all Israel had gathered at Shechem to make him king.
en.R: Rehoboam went to the town of Shechem. All the people of Israel had gathered there to make him their king.

es.L: Y fue Roboam [a] Siquem, porque [a] Siquem había venido todo Israel para hacerlo rey.
es.B: Roboam fue a Siquem, porque todo Israel se había reunido en Siquem para proclamarlo rey.
es.R: Roboam fue a la ciudad de Siquem. Todo el pueblo de Israel se había reunido allí para hacerlo su rey.

fr.L: Et Roboam alla [à] Sichem, car tout Israël était venu [à] Sichem pour le faire roi.
fr.B: Roboam se rendit à Sichem, car tout Israël s’y était rassemblé pour le faire roi.
fr.R: Roboam est allé dans la ville de Sichem. Tout le peuple d’Israël s’y était réuni pour faire de lui son roi.

sw.L: Rehoboamu akaenda Shekemu, kwa maana Israeli wote walikuwa wamefika Shekemu ili kumfanya mfalme.
sw.B: Rehoboamu alikwenda Shekemu, kwa sababu Israeli wote walikuwa wamekusanyika Shekemu ili kumfanya mfalme.
sw.R: Rehoboamu alikwenda katika mji wa Shekemu. Watu wote wa Israeli walikuwa wamekusanyika huko ili wamfanye kuwa mfalme wao.

vi.L: Rô-bô-am đi [đến] Si-chem, vì cả Y-sơ-ra-ên đã đến Si-chem để lập ông làm vua.
vi.B: Rô-bô-am đi đến Si-chem, vì cả Y-sơ-ra-ên đã tụ họp tại Si-chem để tôn ông làm vua.
vi.R: Rô-bô-am đến thành Si-chem. Toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đã tụ họp tại đó để tôn ông làm vua của họ.

ko.L: 그리고 르호보암이 세겜으로 갔다. 온 이스라엘이 그를 왕으로 세우려고 세겜에 왔기 때문이다.
ko.B: 르호보암은 세겜으로 갔다. 온 이스라엘이 그를 왕으로 세우려고 세겜에 모였기 때문이다.
ko.R: 르호보암은 세겜이라는 성읍으로 갔다. 이스라엘의 모든 백성이 그를 자기들의 왕으로 세우려고 그곳에 모여 있었다.

decisions.choice: Shechem: the old meeting place of the northern tribes
decisions.reason: Shechem lay in the hill country of Ephraim (verse 25). Joshua gathered the tribes there to renew the covenant (Joshua 24:1, 25), and Abimelech was made king there (Judges 9:6). Rehoboam goes to the northern tribes; they do not come to him in Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: to make him king: to accept him as their king
decisions.reason: Solomon's son already reigned in Jerusalem (11:43), but the tribes of Israel still had to accept him. The elders of Israel had made a covenant with David before they anointed him king over them (2 Samuel 5:1-3), and the meeting at Shechem expects something similar.

decisions.choice: the town of Shechem; their king
decisions.reason: Readable says that Shechem is a town and makes clear whose king Rehoboam was to be.

decisions.choice: "Roboam"; "Siquem"
decisions.reason: Names as the Kings and Chronicles terms note sets (Roboam) and the usual Spanish form of Shechem, already used in the published Spanish Genesis and Joshua drafts. Recorded once for 1 Kings 12-22.

decisions.choice: passé simple for narration at L and B, passé composé at R
decisions.reason: As the French style guide (section 3) and the Kings and Chronicles terms note set out, for this block of chapters (1 Kings 12-22): the passé simple is the normal tense of written narrative, used at Literal and Balanced; Readable uses the passé composé. Speech keeps the tenses of speech at every level, and repeated action is in the imparfait.

decisions.choice: "Sichem"
decisions.reason: The usual French form of the town’s name, as in the French Pentateuch (Genesis 12:6; 33:18); used for the whole book.

decisions.choice: names: "Rô-bô-am", "Si-chem"
decisions.reason: "Rô-bô-am" is the Kings and Chronicles terms note's form; "Si-chem" is the form Genesis already uses for Shechem.

source.text: וַיְהִ֞י כִּשְׁמֹ֣עַ׀יָרָבְעָ֣ם בֶּן־נְבָ֗ט וְהוּא֙ עוֹדֶ֣נּוּ בְמִצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֣ר בָּרַ֔ח מִפְּנֵ֖י הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ שְׁלֹמֹ֑ה וַיֵּ֥שֶׁב יָרָבְעָ֖ם בְּמִצְרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was, when heard Jeroboam son of Nebat, and he [was] still in Egypt, where he had fled from [the] face of the king Solomon, and dwelt Jeroboam in Egypt.

en.L: And it happened, when Jeroboam son of Nebat heard [it] (and he [was] still in Egypt, where he had fled from the presence of King Solomon), that Jeroboam stayed in Egypt.
en.B: When Jeroboam son of Nebat heard about it, he was still in Egypt, where he had taken refuge from King Solomon, and he remained in Egypt.
en.R: Jeroboam son of Nebat heard the news while he was still in Egypt. He had run away there from King Solomon, and he stayed there.

es.L: Y sucedió que, cuando lo oyó Jeroboam hijo de Nabat (y él [estaba] todavía en Egipto, adonde había huido de la presencia del rey Salomón), Jeroboam se quedó en Egipto.
es.B: Cuando Jeroboam hijo de Nabat se enteró de ello, todavía estaba en Egipto, donde se había refugiado huyendo del rey Salomón, y se quedó en Egipto.
es.R: Jeroboam hijo de Nabat recibió la noticia cuando todavía estaba en Egipto. Había huido allí del rey Salomón, y allí se quedó.

fr.L: Et il arriva, quand Jéroboam fils de Nebath l’apprit (or il [était] encore en Égypte, où il s’était enfui loin de la face du roi Salomon), que Jéroboam resta en Égypte.
fr.B: Quand Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, en eut la nouvelle, il était encore en Égypte, où il avait trouvé refuge loin du roi Salomon, et il demeura en Égypte.
fr.R: Jéroboam, le fils de Nebath, a appris la nouvelle alors qu’il était encore en Égypte. Il s’était enfui là-bas pour échapper au roi Salomon, et il y est resté.

sw.L: Ikawa, Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati aliposikia [habari] (naye [alikuwa] bado yuko Misri, alikokimbilia kutoka mbele ya mfalme Sulemani), Yeroboamu akakaa Misri.
sw.B: Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati aliposikia habari hiyo, alikuwa bado yuko Misri, alikokimbilia kujificha kwa mfalme Sulemani, naye akabaki Misri.
sw.R: Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati alisikia habari hizo alipokuwa bado yuko Misri. Alikuwa amekimbilia huko akimkimbia mfalme Sulemani, naye akabaki huko.

vi.L: Xảy ra, khi Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát nghe [tin] (lúc ấy ông vẫn còn ở Ai Cập, nơi ông đã trốn khỏi mặt vua Sa-lô-môn), thì Giê-rô-bô-am ở lại Ai Cập.
vi.B: Khi Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát nghe tin ấy, ông vẫn còn ở Ai Cập, nơi ông đã lánh nạn khỏi vua Sa-lô-môn, và ông cứ ở lại Ai Cập.
vi.R: Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát nghe tin ấy khi ông vẫn còn ở Ai Cập. Ông đã trốn sang đó để tránh vua Sa-lô-môn, và ông ở lại đó.

ko.L: 그리고 느밧의 아들 여로보암이 [그 소식을] 들었을 때 (그는 아직 이집트에 있었으니, 솔로몬 왕의 얼굴을 피하여 그곳으로 도망갔던 것이다), 여로보암은 이집트에 머물러 있었다.
ko.B: 느밧의 아들 여로보암은 이 소식을 들었을 때 아직 이집트에 있었다. 그는 솔로몬 왕을 피해 그곳으로 도망가 있었는데, 그대로 이집트에 머물러 있었다.
ko.R: 느밧의 아들 여로보암은 아직 이집트에 있을 때 그 소식을 들었다. 그는 솔로몬 왕을 피해 그곳으로 도망갔었고, 그곳에 머물러 있었다.

decisions.choice: Jeroboam had fled to Egypt from Solomon
decisions.reason: Jeroboam, one of Solomon's officials, was told by the prophet Ahijah that he would rule ten tribes; Solomon tried to kill him, and he fled to Shishak king of Egypt and stayed there until Solomon died (11:26-40).

decisions.choice: and Jeroboam stayed in Egypt
decisions.reason: The Hebrew text reads "and Jeroboam stayed (or lived) in Egypt". The parallel in 2 Chronicles 10:2 reads "and Jeroboam returned from Egypt"; the two verbs differ only in their vowels, and Chronicles adds "from". The Hebrew text of Kings is followed: Jeroboam stayed where he was until the tribes sent for him (verse 3).

decisions.choice: heard [it]: news of Solomon's death and the meeting at Shechem
decisions.reason: The verb has no object. What Jeroboam heard is clear from the verses before: Solomon had died and Rehoboam had become king (11:43), and Israel was gathering at Shechem (verse 1).

decisions.choice: parentheses round the clause about Egypt
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets a background clause in the middle of the sentence. Literal marks it off so that the main line, "when Jeroboam heard ... Jeroboam stayed in Egypt", can be followed.

decisions.choice: "Jeroboam hijo de Nabat"
decisions.reason: The form set by the Kings and Chronicles terms note for all four books.

decisions.choice: parentheses round the clause about Egypt
decisions.reason: As the English Literal, the background clause is set off in brackets so that the main line "Yeroboamu aliposikia ... Yeroboamu akakaa Misri" can be followed.

source.text: וַֽיִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ וַיִּקְרְאוּ־ל֔וֹ וַיָּבֹ֥א יָרָבְעָ֖ם וְכָל־קְהַ֣ל יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַֽיְדַבְּר֔וּ אֶל־רְחַבְעָ֖ם לֵאמֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And they sent and called him, and came Jeroboam and all [the] assembly of Israel and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,

en.L: And they sent and called him, and Jeroboam and all the assembly of Israel came and spoke to Rehoboam, saying,
en.B: So they sent and summoned him, and Jeroboam and the whole assembly of Israel came and said to Rehoboam,
en.R: So the people sent for him. Then Jeroboam and the whole gathering of Israel came and said to Rehoboam,

es.L: Y enviaron y lo llamaron, y vino Jeroboam con toda la asamblea de Israel, y hablaron a Roboam, diciendo:
es.B: Entonces mandaron a llamarlo, y Jeroboam y toda la asamblea de Israel vinieron y le dijeron a Roboam:
es.R: Entonces el pueblo mandó a buscarlo. Luego Jeroboam y toda la gente de Israel reunida fueron y le dijeron a Roboam:

fr.L: Et ils envoyèrent [quelqu’un] et l’appelèrent ; et Jéroboam et toute l’assemblée d’Israël vinrent, et ils parlèrent à Roboam en disant :
fr.B: On le fit donc appeler, et Jéroboam vint avec toute l’assemblée d’Israël, et ils dirent à Roboam :
fr.R: Alors les gens l’ont fait venir. Puis Jéroboam et tout le rassemblement d’Israël sont venus dire à Roboam :

sw.L: Wakatuma wakamwita, naye Yeroboamu na kusanyiko lote la Israeli wakaja, wakasema na Rehoboamu, wakisema,
sw.B: Basi wakatuma watu kumwita, naye Yeroboamu pamoja na kusanyiko lote la Israeli wakaja, wakamwambia Rehoboamu,
sw.R: Kwa hiyo watu walituma mtu akamwite. Kisha Yeroboamu na mkutano wote wa Israeli wakaja, wakamwambia Rehoboamu,

vi.L: Họ sai [người] đi gọi ông; rồi Giê-rô-bô-am và cả hội chúng Y-sơ-ra-ên đến nói với Rô-bô-am rằng:
vi.B: Vậy họ sai người đi mời ông về. Giê-rô-bô-am và cả hội chúng Y-sơ-ra-ên đến thưa với Rô-bô-am:
vi.R: Vậy dân chúng sai người đi gọi ông về. Rồi Giê-rô-bô-am và toàn thể dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đang tụ họp đến nói với Rô-bô-am:

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 사람을 보내어 그를 불렀고, 여로보암과 이스라엘의 온 회중이 와서 르호보암에게 말했다.
ko.B: 그래서 그들이 사람을 보내 여로보암을 불렀다. 여로보암과 이스라엘의 온 회중이 와서 르호보암에게 말했다.
ko.R: 그래서 백성은 사람을 보내 여로보암을 불러왔다. 여로보암과 이스라엘의 모든 무리가 와서 르호보암에게 말했다.

decisions.choice: they sent: the tribes of Israel
decisions.reason: The subject is not named; it is the people of Israel gathered at Shechem (verse 1), who call Jeroboam back to speak for them.

decisions.choice: the assembly of Israel: the tribes gathered as one body
decisions.reason: The word names the people assembled for a public act, as when Israel gathered before Solomon at the dedication of the temple (8:14, 22). Here the gathered tribes speak to the king together.

decisions.choice: came: the form marked to be read aloud is singular
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) and the form the scribes marked to be read aloud (qere) differ in the verb "came", between plural and singular. The singular agrees with Jeroboam, named first. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: Jeroboam takes part in the meeting, though verse 20 tells of his return later
decisions.reason: Verses 3 and 12 have Jeroboam lead the people, while verse 20 says that Israel heard he had returned and then called him to the assembly. Verse 20 may look back on the same events from the side of the northern tribes. The old Greek translation does not name Jeroboam in this meeting.

decisions.choice: the whole gathering of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable uses "gathering" for the assembly, as the Numbers to Ruth terms allow.

decisions.choice: "la asamblea de Israel" (L, B); "toda la gente de Israel reunida" (R)
decisions.reason: The Pentateuch note's word for *qahal* is "asamblea"; Readable follows the English "gathering" with a plain phrase.

decisions.choice: "le rassemblement d’Israël" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says "rassemblement" for the assembly, as the English Readable says "gathering"; Literal and Balanced keep "l’assemblée".

decisions.choice: mkutano
decisions.reason: Readable says "mkutano" (a gathering, a meeting) for the assembly, the everyday word, where Literal and Balanced keep "kusanyiko", as the Pentateuch note has for *qahal*.

decisions.choice: "hội chúng" for the assembly
decisions.reason: "hội chúng" names the people gathered as one body, the word used for Israel assembled before the LORD; Readable says "toàn thể dân ... đang tụ họp", as the English Readable says "gathering".

source.text: אָבִ֖יךָ הִקְשָׁ֣ה אֶת־עֻלֵּ֑נוּ וְאַתָּ֡ה עַתָּ֣ה הָקֵל֩ מֵעֲבֹדַ֨ת אָבִ֜יךָ הַקָּשָׁ֗ה וּמֵעֻלּ֧וֹ הַכָּבֵ֛ד אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥ן עָלֵ֖ינוּ וְנַעַבְדֶֽךָּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Your father made hard our yoke; and you, now, lighten from [the] service of your father the hard and from his yoke the heavy which he put on us, and we will serve you.

en.L: "Your father made our yoke hard. And you, now, lighten [some] of the hard service of your father and of his heavy yoke that he put on us, and we will serve you."
en.B: "Your father made our yoke hard. Now ease the harsh labor your father demanded and the heavy yoke he laid on us, and we will serve you."
en.R: "Your father made life hard for us. He put a heavy load on us, like a heavy yoke on an ox. Now make our hard work easier and our load lighter, and we will serve you."

es.L: «Tu padre hizo duro nuestro yugo; y tú, ahora, aligera [algo] de la dura servidumbre de tu padre y de su pesado yugo que puso sobre nosotros, y te serviremos».
es.B: «Tu padre nos impuso un yugo duro. Ahora alivia tú el duro trabajo que tu padre nos exigía y el pesado yugo que nos echó encima, y te serviremos».
es.R: «Tu padre nos hizo la vida muy dura. Nos puso una carga pesada, como un yugo pesado sobre un buey. Ahora haz más fácil nuestro duro trabajo y más ligera nuestra carga, y te serviremos».

fr.L: « Ton père a rendu notre joug dur. Et toi, maintenant, allège [une part] du dur service de ton père et de son joug pesant qu’il a mis sur nous, et nous te servirons. »
fr.B: « Ton père a rendu notre joug pesant. Maintenant, allège le dur travail que ton père exigeait et le lourd joug qu’il nous a imposé, et nous te servirons. »
fr.R: « Ton père nous a rendu la vie dure. Il a mis sur nous une lourde charge, comme un joug pesant sur le cou d’un bœuf. Maintenant, rends notre travail moins dur et notre charge plus légère, et nous te servirons. »

sw.L: "Baba yako aliifanya nira yetu kuwa ngumu. Basi wewe sasa, upunguze [kiasi] cha utumishi mgumu wa baba yako na cha nira yake nzito aliyotutwika, nasi tutakutumikia."
sw.B: "Baba yako aliifanya nira yetu kuwa ngumu. Sasa basi, upunguze kazi ngumu aliyotudai baba yako na nira nzito aliyotutwika, nasi tutakutumikia."
sw.R: "Baba yako aliyafanya maisha yetu kuwa magumu. Alituwekea mzigo mzito, kama nira nzito shingoni mwa ng'ombe. Sasa tupunguzie kazi yetu ngumu na mzigo wetu uwe mwepesi, nasi tutakutumikia."

vi.L: "Cha ngài đã làm cho cái ách của chúng tôi nặng nề. Vậy bây giờ, xin ngài làm nhẹ bớt [phần nào] công việc nặng nề của cha ngài và cái ách nặng mà ông đã đặt trên chúng tôi, thì chúng tôi sẽ phục vụ ngài."
vi.B: "Cha ngài đã đặt trên chúng tôi một cái ách nặng nề. Bây giờ xin ngài giảm bớt công việc khổ nhọc mà cha ngài bắt chúng tôi làm và cái ách nặng ông đã đặt trên chúng tôi, thì chúng tôi sẽ phục vụ ngài."
vi.R: "Cha ngài đã làm cho đời sống chúng tôi khổ cực. Ông chất lên chúng tôi một gánh nặng, như cái ách nặng đặt trên cổ con bò. Bây giờ xin ngài làm cho công việc nặng nhọc của chúng tôi dễ hơn và gánh của chúng tôi nhẹ hơn, thì chúng tôi sẽ phục vụ ngài."

ko.L: "임금님의 아버지께서 우리의 멍에를 가혹하게 하셨습니다. 그러니 이제 임금님께서는 임금님의 아버지께서 시키신 가혹한 노역과 우리에게 지우신 무거운 멍에를 [얼마간] 가볍게 해 주십시오. 그러면 우리가 임금님을 섬기겠습니다."
ko.B: "임금님의 아버지께서 우리에게 무거운 멍에를 지우셨습니다. 이제 부친께서 시키신 가혹한 노역과 우리에게 지우신 무거운 멍에를 가볍게 해 주십시오. 그러면 우리가 임금님을 섬기겠습니다."
ko.R: "임금님의 아버지께서는 우리를 너무 힘들게 하셨습니다. 소의 목에 무거운 멍에를 씌우듯이 우리에게 무거운 짐을 지우셨습니다. 이제 우리의 고된 일을 덜어 주시고 짐을 가볍게 해 주십시오. 그러면 우리가 임금님을 섬기겠습니다."

decisions.choice: yoke: the burden of the king's demands
decisions.reason: A yoke is the wooden bar laid on the necks of oxen so that they can pull. Here it stands for what Solomon required of his people: forced labor on his buildings (5:27-28; 9:15; 11:28) and the food supplied for his court (5:2-8).

decisions.choice: service: work owed to the king
decisions.reason: The word is the ordinary word for work or service; with "hard" it recalls Israel's hard service in Egypt (Exodus 1:14; 6:9). The people describe Solomon's rule in the words used of Pharaoh.

decisions.choice: lighten some of: a request for relief, not for an end to all service
decisions.reason: The preposition "from" means "part of". The people ask the king to reduce the load, and they promise to serve him if he does.

decisions.choice: we will serve you: loyalty on terms
decisions.reason: The tribes offer to accept Rehoboam as king on a condition. Their loyalty depends on how he answers.

decisions.choice: like a heavy yoke on an ox
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of the yoke once and then speaks of a load.

decisions.choice: "tú" to Rehoboam, and quotation marks « “ ‘ ’ ” »
decisions.reason: As the Samuel and Kings notes set: one person, the king included, is addressed with "tú", never "usted"; speech takes « » with “ ” and ‘ ’ inside.

decisions.choice: kama nira nzito shingoni mwa ng'ombe
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, Readable explains the picture of the yoke once ("nira", the bar laid on an ox's neck) and then speaks of a load ("mzigo").

decisions.choice: the assembly calls Rehoboam "ngài" and themselves "chúng tôi"
decisions.reason: The tribes have not yet accepted Rehoboam as king and are negotiating on terms; "ngài" is respectful without the court's "bệ hạ", which his own courtiers use below.

decisions.choice: the people speak to Rehoboam in 합쇼체, calling him "임금님"
decisions.reason: As in Samuel, subjects address the king in 합쇼체 with "임금님". The tribes have not yet accepted Rehoboam, but they still petition him as king; their tone changes in verse 16.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם לְכ֥וּ עֹ֛ד שְׁלֹשָׁ֥ה יָמִ֖ים וְשׁ֣וּבוּ אֵלָ֑י וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ הָעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to them, Go yet three days and return to me. And went the people.

en.L: And he said to them, "Go [away] yet three days, and return to me." And the people went.
en.B: He said to them, "Go away for three days, then come back to me." So the people left.
en.R: Rehoboam answered, "Go away for three days. Then come back to me." So the people left.

es.L: Y él les dijo: «{{plural_you:Váyanse|Idos}} por tres días y {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} a mí». Y se fue el pueblo.
es.B: Él les dijo: «{{plural_you:Váyanse|Idos}} por tres días y luego {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} a verme». Y el pueblo se fue.
es.R: Roboam les respondió: «{{plural_you:Váyanse|Idos}} por tres días. Después {{plural_you:vuelvan|volved}} a verme». Y el pueblo se fue.

fr.L: Et il leur dit : « Allez[-vous-en] encore trois jours, et revenez vers moi. » Et le peuple s’en alla.
fr.B: Il leur répondit : « Partez pour trois jours, puis revenez me voir. » Et le peuple s’en alla.
fr.R: Roboam leur a répondu : « Partez pendant trois jours. Ensuite, revenez me voir. » Et le peuple est parti.

sw.L: Akawaambia, "Nendeni [zenu] bado siku tatu, kisha mrudi kwangu." Watu wakaenda.
sw.B: Akawaambia, "Nendeni kwa siku tatu, kisha mrudi kwangu." Basi watu wakaondoka.
sw.R: Rehoboamu akajibu, "Nendeni kwa siku tatu. Kisha mrudi kwangu." Basi watu wakaondoka.

vi.L: Ông nói với họ: "Hãy đi [đi] thêm ba ngày nữa, rồi trở lại với ta." Và dân chúng đi.
vi.B: Ông bảo họ: "Hãy đi về ba ngày, rồi trở lại gặp ta." Vậy dân chúng ra về.
vi.R: Rô-bô-am trả lời: "Hãy đi về ba ngày. Sau đó trở lại gặp ta." Vậy dân chúng ra về.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그들에게 말했다. "아직 사흘 동안 가 있다가 내게 돌아오너라." 그리고 백성이 갔다.
ko.B: 그가 그들에게 말했다. "사흘 동안 물러가 있다가 다시 내게 오너라." 그러자 백성이 물러갔다.
ko.R: 르호보암이 대답했다. "사흘 동안 돌아가 있다가 다시 나에게 오너라." 그래서 백성은 돌아갔다.

decisions.choice: for three days: until the third day
decisions.reason: The people come back "on the third day" (verse 12), so the three days are counted with the first and last included, as was usual.

decisions.choice: Rehoboam answered
decisions.reason: Readable names the speaker.

source.text: וַיִּוָּעַ֞ץ הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ רְחַבְעָ֗ם אֶת־הַזְּקֵנִים֙ אֲשֶׁר־הָי֣וּ עֹמְדִ֗ים אֶת־פְּנֵי֙ שְׁלֹמֹ֣ה אָבִ֔יו בִּֽהְיֹת֥וֹ חַ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר אֵ֚יךְ אַתֶּ֣ם נֽוֹעָצִ֔ים לְהָשִׁ֥יב אֶת־הָֽעָם־הַזֶּ֖ה דָּבָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And consulted the king Rehoboam with the elders who had been standing before Solomon his father while he was alive, saying, How you counsel to bring back [to] this people word?

en.L: And King Rehoboam took counsel with the elders who had stood before Solomon his father while he was alive, saying, "How do you counsel [me] to return a word to this people?"
en.B: King Rehoboam then consulted the elders who had served his father Solomon while he was alive. "What answer do you advise me to give this people?" he asked.
en.R: Then King Rehoboam asked for advice from the older men who had served his father Solomon while he was alive. He asked them, "How should I answer these people?"

es.L: Y el rey Roboam tomó consejo con los ancianos que habían estado delante de Salomón su padre mientras vivía, diciendo: «¿Cómo {{plural_you:aconsejan ustedes|aconsejáis vosotros}} que se responda a este pueblo?».
es.B: Entonces el rey Roboam consultó a los ancianos que habían servido a su padre Salomón mientras vivía. «¿Qué respuesta me {{plural_you:aconsejan|aconsejáis}} que le dé a este pueblo?», les preguntó.
es.R: Entonces el rey Roboam pidió consejo a los hombres mayores que habían servido a su padre Salomón mientras vivía. Les preguntó: «¿Cómo debo responder a esta gente?».

fr.L: Et le roi Roboam prit conseil auprès des anciens qui s’étaient tenus devant Salomon son père pendant qu’il était vivant, en disant : « Comment conseillez-vous de répondre une parole à ce peuple ? »
fr.B: Le roi Roboam consulta alors les anciens qui avaient servi son père Salomon de son vivant. « Quelle réponse me conseillez-vous de donner à ce peuple ? » leur demanda-t-il.
fr.R: Alors le roi Roboam a demandé conseil aux hommes âgés qui avaient servi son père Salomon pendant sa vie. Il leur a demandé : « Comment dois-je répondre à ces gens ? »

sw.L: Mfalme Rehoboamu akashauriana na wazee waliokuwa wakisimama mbele ya Sulemani baba yake alipokuwa hai, akisema, "Mnanishauri vipi kuwarudishia watu hawa neno?"
sw.B: Ndipo mfalme Rehoboamu akataka shauri kwa wazee waliomtumikia Sulemani baba yake alipokuwa hai. Akauliza, "Mnanishauri niwajibu nini watu hawa?"
sw.R: Ndipo mfalme Rehoboamu akaomba ushauri kwa wanaume wazee waliomtumikia Sulemani baba yake alipokuwa hai. Akawauliza, "Niwajibu nini watu hawa?"

vi.L: Vua Rô-bô-am bàn hỏi các trưởng lão đã từng đứng trước mặt Sa-lô-môn, cha ông, khi người còn sống, rằng: "Các ông khuyên [ta] phải trả lời dân này thế nào?"
vi.B: Bấy giờ vua Rô-bô-am bàn hỏi các bậc lão thành đã từng phục vụ vua Sa-lô-môn, cha mình, khi vua còn sống. Vua hỏi: "Các ông khuyên ta nên trả lời dân này thế nào?"
vi.R: Rồi vua Rô-bô-am xin ý kiến những người lớn tuổi đã từng phục vụ vua Sa-lô-môn, cha mình, khi vua còn sống. Vua hỏi họ: "Ta nên trả lời dân này thế nào?"

ko.L: 그리고 르호보암 왕이 그의 아버지 솔로몬이 살아 있을 때에 그 앞에 서 있던 원로들과 의논하며 말했다. "이 백성에게 말을 돌려주도록 그대들은 어떻게 조언하겠소?"
ko.B: 르호보암 왕은 자기 아버지 솔로몬이 살아 있을 때 그를 섬기던 원로들과 의논했다. 그가 물었다. "이 백성에게 어떻게 대답하라고 조언하겠소?"
ko.R: 그러자 르호보암 왕은 아버지 솔로몬이 살아 있을 때 그를 섬기던 나이 든 신하들에게 의견을 물었다. "이 백성에게 어떻게 대답하면 좋겠소?"

decisions.choice: the elders: older men who had been Solomon's advisers
decisions.reason: The word means older men. Here they are senior members of the court who had served Solomon, set against the young men who had grown up with Rehoboam (verse 8); they are not the elders of the tribes.

decisions.choice: stood before: served as attendants and advisers
decisions.reason: To stand before a king is to wait on him and be ready to serve him (1:2; 10:8).

decisions.choice: return a word: give an answer
decisions.reason: "Bring back a word" is the usual Hebrew way of saying "answer"; it returns in verses 9 and 16.

decisions.choice: older men
decisions.reason: Readable says "older men" so that readers do not think of the leaders of the tribes.

decisions.choice: "los ancianos" (L, B); "los hombres mayores" (R)
decisions.reason: These are older advisers rather than town elders; Readable says "hombres mayores", as the English says "older men".

decisions.choice: "les hommes âgés" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable says "older men": Readable keeps readers from taking them for the elders of the tribes; Literal and Balanced say "les anciens".

decisions.choice: wanaume wazee
decisions.reason: "Wazee" alone is also the word for the elders who lead a tribe or town; Readable says "wanaume wazee" (older men), as the English Readable does, so these are seen as Solomon's old advisers.

decisions.choice: "trưởng lão" (L); "bậc lão thành" (B); "những người lớn tuổi" (R)
decisions.reason: These are Solomon's senior advisers, not the elders of the tribes; Balanced and Readable say so with words for older counsellors, as the English Readable says "older men".

decisions.choice: Rehoboam says "các ông" to his father's advisers and "ta" for himself
decisions.reason: The king speaks to the honoured older men of his father's court with "các ông"; to the young men of his own age he says "các ngươi" (verse 9).

decisions.choice: Rehoboam speaks to his father's elders in 하오체 ("그대들", "-소")
alternatives: 해라체, as to the young men (verse 9)
decisions.reason: The king speaks down to his subjects, but these are the senior men of his father's court. 하오체 gives them the respect a king can show, as David speaks to Nathan and Barzillai in Samuel, and it sets them apart from the young men he speaks to as equals in 해라체.

decisions.choice: "원로들" (L, B), "나이 든 신하들" (R)
decisions.reason: "장로들" would suggest the elders of the tribes or of a church; these are senior men of the court (meaning decision). Readable says plainly that they were older officials.

source.text: וַיְדַבְּר֨וּאֵלָ֜יו לֵאמֹ֗ר אִם־הַ֠יּוֹם תִּֽהְיֶה־עֶ֜בֶד לָעָ֤ם הַזֶּה֙ וַֽעֲבַדְתָּ֔ם וַעֲנִיתָ֕ם וְדִבַּרְתָּ֥ אֲלֵיהֶ֖ם דְּבָרִ֣ים טוֹבִ֑ים וְהָי֥וּ לְךָ֛ עֲבָדִ֖ים כָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And they spoke to him, saying, If today you will be a servant to this people and serve them and answer them and speak to them good words, then they will be to you servants all the days.

en.L: And they spoke to him, saying, "If today you will be a slave to this people and serve them, and answer them and speak good words to them, then they will be slaves to you all the days."
en.B: They answered him, "If today you will be a servant to this people and serve them, and answer them with kind words, they will always be your servants."
en.R: They told him, "If you will be a servant to these people today and serve them, and if you give them a kind answer, they will always be your servants."

es.L: Y ellos le hablaron, diciendo: «Si hoy eres esclavo de este pueblo y lo sirves, y les respondes y les hablas buenas palabras, ellos serán esclavos tuyos todos los días».
es.B: Ellos le respondieron: «Si hoy te pones al servicio de este pueblo y lo sirves, y les respondes con palabras amables, ellos serán siempre tus siervos».
es.R: Ellos le dijeron: «Si hoy te haces siervo de esta gente y la sirves, y si les das una respuesta amable, ellos serán siempre tus siervos».

fr.L: Et ils lui parlèrent en disant : « Si aujourd’hui tu es esclave de ce peuple et que tu le serves, et que tu leur répondes et leur dises de bonnes paroles, alors ils seront tes esclaves tous les jours. »
fr.B: Ils lui répondirent : « Si aujourd’hui tu te fais le serviteur de ce peuple, si tu le sers et lui réponds par des paroles bienveillantes, ils seront toujours tes serviteurs. »
fr.R: Ils lui ont dit : « Si aujourd’hui tu acceptes d’être le serviteur de ces gens et de les servir, et si tu leur donnes une réponse bienveillante, ils seront toujours tes serviteurs. »

sw.L: Wakasema naye, wakisema, "Ikiwa leo utakuwa mtumwa kwa watu hawa na kuwatumikia, na kuwajibu na kuwaambia maneno mazuri, ndipo watakuwa watumwa wako siku zote."
sw.B: Wakamjibu, "Ikiwa leo utakuwa mtumishi wa watu hawa na kuwatumikia, ukawajibu kwa maneno mazuri, watakuwa watumishi wako siku zote."
sw.R: Wakamwambia, "Kama leo utakuwa mtumishi wa watu hawa na kuwatumikia, na ukiwajibu kwa upole, watakuwa watumishi wako daima."

vi.L: Họ nói với ông rằng: "Nếu hôm nay vua làm nô lệ cho dân này và phục vụ họ, đáp lời họ và nói với họ những lời tốt đẹp, thì họ sẽ làm nô lệ cho vua mọi ngày."
vi.B: Họ thưa với vua: "Nếu hôm nay bệ hạ chịu làm đầy tớ của dân này, phục vụ họ và đáp lời họ cách ân cần, thì họ sẽ làm đầy tớ của bệ hạ mãi mãi."
vi.R: Họ thưa: "Nếu hôm nay đức vua chịu làm đầy tớ của dân này và phục vụ họ, nếu đức vua trả lời họ cách tử tế, thì họ sẽ luôn luôn làm đầy tớ của đức vua."

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그에게 말했다. "만일 오늘 임금님께서 이 백성에게 종이 되시어 그들을 섬기시고, 그들에게 대답하시며 좋은 말로 말씀하시면, 그들이 모든 날 동안 임금님의 종이 될 것입니다."
ko.B: 그들이 그에게 대답했다. "임금님께서 오늘 이 백성의 종이 되어 그들을 섬기시고 좋은 말로 대답해 주시면, 그들은 언제까지나 임금님의 종이 될 것입니다."
ko.R: 그들이 왕에게 말했다. "임금님께서 오늘 이 백성을 종처럼 섬기시고 친절하게 대답해 주시면, 그들은 언제나 임금님의 종이 될 것입니다."

decisions.choice: be a servant to this people, and they will be your servants
decisions.reason: The elders' advice turns on one word: if the king will serve the people for a day, they will serve him for good. The king rules best by serving those he rules (compare Deuteronomy 17:14-20).

decisions.choice: good words: a kind and favorable answer
decisions.reason: "Good words" are gracious words that grant what is asked. The phrase can also mean a promise of good terms.

decisions.choice: today: on this day of decision
decisions.reason: The elders contrast one day of yielding with "all the days" of loyalty that would follow.

decisions.choice: they spoke: the form marked to be read aloud is plural
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) have "he spoke"; the reading the scribes marked (qere) is "they spoke", agreeing with the elders. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: slave (Literal); servant (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As the style guide sets out for this word, Literal keeps "slave" and Balanced and Readable say "servant". The point is service, not ownership.

decisions.choice: "esclavo" (L); "siervo", "al servicio" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch and Psalms notes set for *ʿeved*: esclavo at Literal, siervo at Balanced and Readable, matching the English slave / servant.

decisions.choice: "esclave" (L); "serviteur" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note and the English decision: Literal keeps "esclave" for *ʿeved*, Balanced and Readable say "serviteur", since the point is service, not ownership.

decisions.choice: mtumwa (Literal); mtumishi (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: *ʿEved* is "mtumwa" at Literal and "mtumishi" at Balanced and Readable, as the Pentateuch and Samuel notes set; the point here is service, not ownership.

decisions.choice: the advisers call the king "vua" (L), "bệ hạ" (B), "đức vua" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms notes' address forms for subjects speaking to the king, used through this block.

decisions.choice: "종" at every level
decisions.reason: Korean "종" covers both slave and servant, and the elders' point is service, not ownership; the English Literal's "slave" needs no separate word here, as the Genesis note sets "종" for *ʿeved*.

source.text: וַֽיַּעֲזֹ֛ב אֶת־עֲצַ֥ת הַזְּקֵנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֣ר יְעָצֻ֑הוּ וַיִּוָּעַ֗ץ אֶת־הַיְלָדִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר גָּדְל֣וּ אִתּ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָעֹמְדִ֖ים לְפָנָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he abandoned the counsel of the elders which they counseled him, and consulted with the young men who had grown up with him, who [were] the ones standing before him.

en.L: And he forsook the counsel of the elders that they had counseled him, and he took counsel with the young men who had grown up with him, who [were] standing before him.
en.B: But he rejected the advice the elders had given him and consulted the young men who had grown up with him and now served him.
en.R: But Rehoboam did not follow the older men's advice. Instead he asked the young men who had grown up with him and now served him.

es.L: Pero él dejó el consejo de los ancianos que le habían aconsejado, y tomó consejo con los jóvenes que se habían criado con él, los que estaban delante de él.
es.B: Pero él rechazó el consejo que le habían dado los ancianos y consultó a los jóvenes que se habían criado con él y que ahora estaban a su servicio.
es.R: Pero Roboam no siguió el consejo de los hombres mayores. En cambio, consultó a los jóvenes que se habían criado con él y que ahora lo servían.

fr.L: Et il abandonna le conseil des anciens, qu’ils lui avaient conseillé, et il prit conseil auprès des jeunes gens qui avaient grandi avec lui, qui se tenaient devant lui.
fr.B: Mais il rejeta le conseil que les anciens lui avaient donné, et il consulta les jeunes gens qui avaient grandi avec lui et qui étaient maintenant à son service.
fr.R: Mais Roboam n’a pas suivi le conseil des hommes âgés. Il a plutôt interrogé les jeunes gens qui avaient grandi avec lui et qui étaient maintenant à son service.

sw.L: Lakini akaliacha shauri la wazee walilomshauri, akashauriana na vijana waliokua pamoja naye, waliokuwa wakisimama mbele yake.
sw.B: Lakini akakataa shauri ambalo wazee walimpa, akataka shauri kwa vijana waliokua pamoja naye na ambao sasa walimtumikia.
sw.R: Lakini Rehoboamu hakufuata ushauri wa wale wanaume wazee. Badala yake akawauliza vijana waliokua pamoja naye na ambao sasa walimtumikia.

vi.L: Nhưng ông bỏ lời khuyên mà các trưởng lão đã khuyên ông, và bàn hỏi những người trẻ đã cùng lớn lên với ông, là những người đang đứng trước mặt ông.
vi.B: Nhưng vua gạt bỏ lời khuyên của các bậc lão thành và bàn hỏi những người trẻ đã cùng lớn lên với mình, nay đang phục vụ mình.
vi.R: Nhưng Rô-bô-am không theo lời khuyên của những người lớn tuổi. Thay vào đó, ông hỏi ý kiến những người trẻ đã cùng lớn lên với ông và nay đang phục vụ ông.

ko.L: 그러나 그는 원로들이 그에게 조언한 조언을 버리고, 그와 함께 자라서 그 앞에 서 있는 젊은이들과 의논했다.
ko.B: 그러나 그는 원로들이 해 준 조언을 저버리고, 자기와 함께 자라서 지금 자기를 섬기는 젊은이들과 의논했다.
ko.R: 그러나 르호보암은 나이 든 신하들의 조언을 따르지 않았다. 그 대신 자기와 함께 자라서 지금 자기를 섬기고 있는 젊은이들에게 물었다.

decisions.choice: forsook: set aside, rejected
decisions.reason: The verb means to leave or abandon. Rehoboam does not merely disagree with the elders' advice; he throws it aside.

decisions.choice: the young men: Rehoboam's companions of his own age
decisions.reason: The word usually means children or boys. Rehoboam was forty-one when he became king (14:21), so these are not boys; calling them by this word may hint at their lack of judgment.

decisions.choice: standing before him: serving him
decisions.reason: As in verse 6, to stand before the king is to serve him. These young men now held places at Rehoboam's court.

decisions.choice: did not follow
decisions.reason: Readable puts "forsook" in plain words and names Rehoboam.

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם מָ֚ה אַתֶּ֣ם נֽוֹעָצִ֔ים וְנָשִׁ֥יב דָּבָ֖ר אֶת־הָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבְּר֤וּ אֵלַי֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר הָקֵל֙ מִן־הָעֹ֔ל אֲשֶׁר־נָתַ֥ן אָבִ֖יךָ עָלֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to them, What you counsel, and we will bring back word [to] this people who have spoken to me, saying, Lighten from the yoke which put your father on us?

en.L: And he said to them, "What do you counsel, that we may return a word to this people who have spoken to me, saying, 'Lighten [some] of the yoke that your father put on us'?"
en.B: He asked them, "What do you advise? How should we answer this people who have said to me, 'Lighten the yoke your father put on us'?"
en.R: He asked them, "What do you advise? How should we answer these people? They said to me, 'Make the load your father put on us lighter.'"

es.L: Y les dijo: «¿Qué {{plural_you:aconsejan ustedes|aconsejáis vosotros}} que respondamos a este pueblo que me ha hablado, diciendo: “Aligera [algo] del yugo que tu padre puso sobre nosotros”?».
es.B: Les preguntó: «¿Qué me {{plural_you:aconsejan|aconsejáis}}? ¿Cómo debemos responder a este pueblo que me ha dicho: “Aligera el yugo que tu padre nos echó encima”?».
es.R: Les preguntó: «¿Qué me {{plural_you:aconsejan|aconsejáis}}? ¿Cómo debemos responder a esta gente? Me dijeron: “Haz más ligera la carga que tu padre nos puso”».

fr.L: Et il leur dit : « Que conseillez-vous, pour que nous répondions une parole à ce peuple qui m’a parlé en disant : “Allège [une part] du joug que ton père a mis sur nous” ? »
fr.B: Il leur demanda : « Que me conseillez-vous ? Comment devons-nous répondre à ce peuple qui m’a dit : “Allège le joug que ton père a mis sur nous” ? »
fr.R: Il leur a demandé : « Que me conseillez-vous ? Comment devons-nous répondre à ces gens ? Ils m’ont dit : “Rends plus légère la charge que ton père a mise sur nous.” »

sw.L: Akawaambia, "Ninyi mnashauri nini, ili tuwarudishie neno watu hawa walioniambia, wakisema, 'Upunguze [kiasi] cha nira aliyotutwika baba yako'?"
sw.B: Akawauliza, "Ninyi mnashauri nini? Tuwajibu vipi watu hawa walioniambia, 'Upunguze nira aliyotutwika baba yako'?"
sw.R: Akawauliza, "Mnashauri nini? Tuwajibu vipi watu hawa? Wameniambia, 'Upunguze mzigo ambao baba yako alituwekea.'"

vi.L: Ông nói với họ: "Các ngươi khuyên gì, để chúng ta trả lời dân này, là những người đã nói với ta rằng: 'Xin làm nhẹ bớt [phần nào] cái ách mà cha vua đã đặt trên chúng tôi'?"
vi.B: Vua hỏi họ: "Các ngươi khuyên thế nào? Chúng ta nên trả lời dân này ra sao, khi họ nói với ta: 'Xin làm nhẹ bớt cái ách cha ngài đã đặt trên chúng tôi'?"
vi.R: Vua hỏi họ: "Các ngươi khuyên gì? Chúng ta nên trả lời dân này thế nào? Họ nói với ta: 'Xin làm cho gánh nặng cha ngài đặt trên chúng tôi nhẹ bớt.'"

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그들에게 말했다. "너희는 무엇을 조언하여, 우리가 이 백성에게 말을 돌려주게 하겠느냐? 그들이 나에게 '임금님의 아버지께서 우리에게 지우신 멍에를 [얼마간] 가볍게 해 주십시오' 하고 말했다."
ko.B: 그가 그들에게 물었다. "너희 생각은 어떠냐? 이 백성이 나에게 '임금님의 아버지께서 우리에게 지우신 멍에를 가볍게 해 주십시오' 하고 말했는데, 우리가 그들에게 어떻게 대답해야 하겠느냐?"
ko.R: 그가 그들에게 물었다. "너희 생각은 어떠냐? 이 백성에게 우리가 어떻게 대답해야 하겠느냐? 그들은 나에게 '임금님의 아버지께서 우리에게 지우신 짐을 가볍게 해 주십시오' 하고 말했다."

decisions.choice: we: Rehoboam counts the young men in with himself
decisions.reason: To the elders Rehoboam said "to answer" (verse 6); to the young men he says "that we may answer". He treats them as partners in the decision.

decisions.choice: the people's request is repeated in short
decisions.reason: Rehoboam sums up the request of verse 4 in a few words and leaves out the people's promise to serve him.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:aconsejan|aconsejáis}}, and the plural clitics {{plural_you:los|os}}, {{plural_you:les|os}}
decisions.reason: Every plural "you" takes the plural_you span, verbs and clitics included, as the Pentateuch note and the published Samuel drafts do; recorded once for this block.

decisions.choice: Rehoboam speaks to the young men in 해라체, and they answer in 합쇼체
decisions.reason: They are his companions and now his servants. The change from 하오체 with the elders (verse 6) to 해라체 here marks the two groups as Korean must, and "우리" keeps the Hebrew's "we".

source.text: וַיְדַבְּר֣וּ אֵלָ֗יו הַיְלָדִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֨ר גָּדְל֣וּ אִתּוֹ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ כֹּֽה־תֹאמַ֣ר לָעָ֣ם הַזֶּ֡ה אֲשֶׁר֩ דִּבְּר֨וּ אֵלֶ֜יךָ לֵאמֹ֗ר אָבִ֨יךָ֙ הִכְבִּ֣יד אֶת־עֻלֵּ֔נוּ וְאַתָּ֖ה הָקֵ֣ל מֵעָלֵ֑ינוּ כֹּ֚ה תְּדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֔ם קָֽטָנִּ֥י עָבָ֖ה מִמָּתְנֵ֥י אָבִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And spoke to him the young men who had grown up with him, saying, Thus you will say to this people who spoke to you, saying, Your father made heavy our yoke, and you lighten [it] from on us; thus you will speak to them, My little [finger] [is] thick more than [the] loins of my father.

en.L: And the young men who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, "Thus you shall say to this people who spoke to you, saying, 'Your father made our yoke heavy, but you, lighten [it] from on us'; thus you shall speak to them: 'My little [finger] is thicker than the loins of my father.
en.B: The young men who had grown up with him answered, "This people said to you, 'Your father made our yoke heavy, but you must make it lighter for us.' Give them this answer: 'My little finger is thicker than my father's waist.
en.R: The young men who had grown up with him answered, "These people said to you, 'Your father put a heavy load on us. Make it lighter for us.' So tell them this: 'My little finger is thicker than my father's waist! I will be much harder on you than he was.

es.L: Y le hablaron los jóvenes que se habían criado con él, diciendo: «Así dirás a este pueblo que te habló, diciendo: “Tu padre hizo pesado nuestro yugo, pero tú alígeralo de sobre nosotros”; así les hablarás: “Mi [dedo] pequeño es más grueso que los lomos de mi padre.
es.B: Los jóvenes que se habían criado con él le respondieron: «Este pueblo te dijo: “Tu padre nos impuso un yugo pesado, pero tú debes aligerárnoslo”. Dales esta respuesta: “Mi dedo meñique es más grueso que la cintura de mi padre.
es.R: Los jóvenes que se habían criado con él le respondieron: «Esta gente te dijo: “Tu padre nos puso una carga pesada. Hazla más ligera”. Pues diles esto: “¡Mi dedo meñique es más grueso que la cintura de mi padre! Yo seré mucho más duro con {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} que él.

fr.L: Et les jeunes gens qui avaient grandi avec lui lui parlèrent en disant : « Ainsi tu diras à ce peuple qui t’a parlé en disant : “Ton père a rendu notre joug pesant, mais toi, allège-[le] de dessus nous” ; ainsi tu leur parleras : “Mon petit [doigt] est plus épais que les reins de mon père.
fr.B: Les jeunes gens qui avaient grandi avec lui lui répondirent : « Ce peuple t’a dit : “Ton père a rendu notre joug pesant, mais toi, tu dois l’alléger pour nous.” Voici ce que tu leur répondras : “Mon petit doigt est plus gros que la taille de mon père.
fr.R: Les jeunes gens qui avaient grandi avec lui lui ont répondu : « Ces gens t’ont dit : “Ton père a mis sur nous une lourde charge. Rends-la plus légère pour nous.” Alors réponds-leur ceci : “Mon petit doigt est plus gros que la taille de mon père ! Je serai beaucoup plus dur avec vous que lui.

sw.L: Vijana waliokua pamoja naye wakasema naye, wakisema, "Hivi ndivyo utakavyowaambia watu hawa waliosema nawe, wakisema, 'Baba yako aliifanya nira yetu kuwa nzito, lakini wewe, utupunguzie'; hivi ndivyo utakavyowaambia: 'Kidole changu kidogo [ni] kinene kuliko viuno vya baba yangu.
sw.B: Vijana waliokua pamoja naye wakamjibu, "Watu hawa wamekuambia, 'Baba yako aliifanya nira yetu kuwa nzito, lakini wewe lazima utupunguzie.' Wape jibu hili: 'Kidole changu kidogo ni kinene kuliko kiuno cha baba yangu.
sw.R: Vijana waliokua pamoja naye wakajibu, "Watu hawa wamekuambia, 'Baba yako alituwekea mzigo mzito. Utupunguzie.' Basi uwaambie hivi: 'Kidole changu kidogo ni kinene kuliko kiuno cha baba yangu! Nitakuwa mkali kwenu kuliko yeye.

vi.L: Những người trẻ đã cùng lớn lên với ông nói với ông rằng: "Vua hãy nói thế này với dân này, là những người đã nói với vua rằng: 'Cha vua đã làm cho cái ách của chúng tôi nặng, còn vua, hãy làm nhẹ [nó] khỏi chúng tôi'; vua hãy nói với họ thế này: 'Ngón tay út của ta còn dày hơn ngang lưng của cha ta.
vi.B: Những người trẻ đã cùng lớn lên với vua thưa: "Dân này đã nói với bệ hạ: 'Cha ngài đã làm cho ách chúng tôi nặng nề, xin ngài làm nhẹ bớt cho chúng tôi.' Bệ hạ hãy trả lời họ thế này: 'Ngón tay út của ta còn to hơn ngang lưng của cha ta.
vi.R: Những người trẻ đã cùng lớn lên với vua trả lời: "Dân này đã nói với đức vua: 'Cha ngài đã chất gánh nặng lên chúng tôi. Xin ngài làm cho nhẹ bớt.' Vậy đức vua hãy nói với họ: 'Ngón tay út của ta còn to hơn ngang lưng của cha ta! Ta sẽ đối xử với các ngươi khắc nghiệt hơn cha ta nhiều.

ko.L: 그리고 그와 함께 자란 젊은이들이 그에게 말했다. "'임금님의 아버지께서 우리의 멍에를 무겁게 하셨으니, 임금님께서는 우리에게서 [그것을] 가볍게 해 주십시오' 하고 임금님께 말한 이 백성에게 이렇게 말씀하십시오. 그들에게 이렇게 말씀하십시오. '내 새끼[손가락]이 내 아버지의 허리보다 굵다.
ko.B: 그와 함께 자란 젊은이들이 대답했다. "이 백성이 임금님께 '임금님의 아버지께서 우리의 멍에를 무겁게 하셨으니, 임금님께서는 그것을 가볍게 해 주십시오' 하고 말했으니, 그들에게 이렇게 대답하십시오. '내 새끼손가락이 내 아버지의 허리보다 굵다.
ko.R: 그와 함께 자란 젊은이들이 대답했다. "이 백성이 임금님께 '임금님의 아버지께서 우리에게 무거운 짐을 지우셨습니다. 그 짐을 가볍게 해 주십시오' 하고 말했습니다. 그러니 그들에게 이렇게 말씀하십시오. '내 새끼손가락이 내 아버지의 허리보다 굵다! 나는 내 아버지보다 너희를 훨씬 더 혹독하게 다룰 것이다.

decisions.choice: my little finger is thicker than my father's loins: I will be far harsher than my father
decisions.reason: The boast compares the smallest part of the new king with the thickest part of the old one. Rehoboam's least effort will weigh more on them than Solomon's greatest.

decisions.choice: my little [finger]
decisions.reason: The word means "my little one" or "my smallness"; the word for finger is not written but is understood. It appears only here and in the parallel at 2 Chronicles 10:10.

decisions.choice: loins: the waist and hips
decisions.reason: The word names the middle of the body, where a belt is worn, the thickest part of a man.

decisions.choice: the young men tell Rehoboam twice what to say
decisions.reason: "Thus you shall say ... thus you shall speak" frames the people's words and then the answer the young men put into his mouth, which runs on through verse 11.

decisions.choice: waist
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "waist", the ordinary word for this part of the body; Literal keeps "loins".

decisions.choice: I will be much harder on you than he was
decisions.reason: Readable adds a plain sentence that explains the boast. Verse 11 says the same in other words.

decisions.choice: "mi dedo meñique"; "la cintura" (B, R); "los lomos" (L)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the little finger and the waist plainly, as the English does; Literal keeps "lomos" for the Hebrew word and brackets the supplied "dedo".

decisions.choice: "la taille" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the waist, the thickest part of the body, as the English "waist"; Literal keeps "les reins", the old word for the loins.

decisions.choice: kiuno
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "loins" is the waist and hips; Literal keeps the plural "viuno", Balanced and Readable say "kiuno", the ordinary word for a person's waist.

decisions.choice: "ngang lưng" for the loins
decisions.reason: "ngang lưng" names the middle of the body where a belt is worn, the thickest part; it serves all three levels, as Vietnamese has no separate literary word that would help here.

decisions.choice: "허리" at every level
decisions.reason: Korean "허리" names the middle of the body where a belt is worn, both the older "loins" and the plain "waist", so one word serves all three levels.

source.text: וְעַתָּ֗ה אָבִי֙ הֶעְמִ֤יס עֲלֵיכֶם֙ עֹ֣ל כָּבֵ֔ד וַאֲנִ֖י אוֹסִ֣יף עַֽל־עֻלְּכֶ֑ם אָבִ֗י יִסַּ֤ר אֶתְכֶם֙ בַּשּׁוֹטִ֔ים וַאֲנִ֕י אֲיַסֵּ֥ר אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּעַקְרַבִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And now my father loaded on you a yoke heavy, and I will add to your yoke; my father disciplined you with the whips, and I will discipline you with the scorpions.

en.L: And now, my father loaded a heavy yoke on you, but I will add to your yoke. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions.'"
en.B: So then: my father laid a heavy yoke on you, but I will make your yoke heavier still. My father punished you with whips, but I will punish you with scorpions.'"
en.R: My father put a heavy load on you, but I will make it even heavier. My father punished you with whips, but I will punish you with scorpions, which hurt far more!'"

es.L: Y ahora, mi padre cargó sobre {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} un yugo pesado, pero yo añadiré a {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} yugo; mi padre {{plural_you:los|os}} castigó con látigos, pero yo {{plural_you:los|os}} castigaré con escorpiones”».
es.B: Así que, mi padre {{plural_you:les|os}} echó encima un yugo pesado, pero yo lo haré todavía más pesado. Mi padre {{plural_you:los|os}} castigó con látigos, pero yo {{plural_you:los|os}} castigaré con escorpiones”».
es.R: Mi padre {{plural_you:les|os}} puso una carga pesada, pero yo la haré todavía más pesada. Mi padre {{plural_you:los|os}} castigó con látigos, ¡pero yo {{plural_you:los|os}} castigaré con escorpiones, que duelen mucho más!”».

fr.L: Et maintenant, mon père a chargé sur vous un joug pesant, mais moi j’ajouterai à votre joug ; mon père vous a corrigés avec des fouets, mais moi je vous corrigerai avec des scorpions.” »
fr.B: Eh bien, mon père vous a imposé un joug pesant, mais moi, je rendrai votre joug plus pesant encore. Mon père vous a punis avec des fouets, mais moi, je vous punirai avec des scorpions.” »
fr.R: Mon père a mis sur vous une lourde charge, mais moi, je la rendrai encore plus lourde. Mon père vous a punis avec des fouets, mais moi, je vous punirai avec des scorpions, qui font bien plus mal !” »

sw.L: Na sasa, baba yangu aliwatwika nira nzito, lakini mimi nitaiongeza nira yenu. Baba yangu aliwaadhibu kwa mijeledi, lakini mimi nitawaadhibu kwa nge.'"
sw.B: Basi sasa: baba yangu aliwatwika nira nzito, lakini mimi nitaifanya nira yenu kuwa nzito zaidi. Baba yangu aliwaadhibu kwa mijeledi, lakini mimi nitawaadhibu kwa nge.'"
sw.R: Baba yangu aliwatwika mzigo mzito, lakini mimi nitauongeza uzito wake. Baba yangu aliwaadhibu kwa mijeledi, lakini mimi nitawaadhibu kwa nge, wanaouma vibaya zaidi!'"

vi.L: Vậy bây giờ, cha ta đã chất trên các ngươi một cái ách nặng, nhưng ta sẽ thêm vào cái ách của các ngươi. Cha ta đã sửa trị các ngươi bằng roi, nhưng ta sẽ sửa trị các ngươi bằng bọ cạp.'"
vi.B: Thế thì, cha ta đã đặt trên các ngươi một cái ách nặng, còn ta sẽ làm cho ách các ngươi nặng hơn nữa. Cha ta đã trừng phạt các ngươi bằng roi, còn ta sẽ trừng phạt các ngươi bằng bọ cạp.'"
vi.R: Cha ta đã chất gánh nặng lên các ngươi, nhưng ta sẽ làm cho gánh ấy nặng hơn nữa. Cha ta đã trừng phạt các ngươi bằng roi, nhưng ta sẽ trừng phạt các ngươi bằng bọ cạp, còn đau đớn hơn nhiều!'"

ko.L: 이제 내 아버지는 너희에게 무거운 멍에를 지웠으나, 나는 너희 멍에에 더할 것이다. 내 아버지는 채찍으로 너희를 징계했으나, 나는 전갈로 너희를 징계할 것이다.'"
ko.B: 그러니 내 아버지는 너희에게 무거운 멍에를 지웠지만, 나는 그 멍에를 더 무겁게 하겠다. 내 아버지는 채찍으로 너희를 벌했지만, 나는 전갈로 너희를 벌하겠다.'"
ko.R: 내 아버지는 너희에게 무거운 짐을 지웠지만, 나는 그 짐을 더 무겁게 하겠다. 내 아버지는 채찍으로 너희를 때렸지만, 나는 전갈로 너희를 때리겠다. 그것은 훨씬 더 아플 것이다!'"

decisions.choice: scorpions: a far crueler punishment than whips
alternatives: a whip fitted with barbs or spikes
a picture of the scorpion's sting
decisions.reason: The word is the ordinary word for the scorpion. It may name a kind of whip fitted with barbs or spikes that bit into the skin, or the scorpion's sting may simply be set against the whip as a picture of far worse pain. Either way the meaning is the same: Rehoboam will punish much more harshly than Solomon did.

decisions.choice: disciplined: punished in order to correct
decisions.reason: The verb is used of a father correcting a son (Deuteronomy 8:5; Proverbs 19:18). Here it names the harsh treatment of forced laborers by those set over them.

decisions.choice: and now: the conclusion of the boast
decisions.reason: "And now" draws the conclusion from the boast of verse 10 and spells out what it means.

decisions.choice: which hurt far more
decisions.reason: Readable adds what the picture of the scorpion means, so that the threat is clear without a note.

decisions.choice: nge
decisions.reason: "Nge" (scorpions) is kept at every level, as the English keeps the picture; it may name a barbed whip, as the meaning decision says, and Readable adds that it hurts far more.

decisions.choice: "bọ cạp" (scorpions)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has the ordinary word for the scorpion; whether it names a barbed whip is uncertain (see the meaning decision), so the picture is kept and Readable adds what it means.

decisions.choice: the boast in plain 해라체, "내 아버지는" without the honorific
decisions.reason: The words the young men give the king are a threat spoken down to the people; the honorific for his father would soften it.

source.text: וַיָּב֨וֹא יָרָבְעָ֧ם וְכָל־הָעָ֛ם אֶל־רְחַבְעָ֖ם בַּיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֑י כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר שׁ֥וּבוּ אֵלַ֖י בַּיּ֥וֹם הַשְּׁלִישִֽׁי׃

records.literal_gloss: And came Jeroboam and all the people to Rehoboam on the day the third, as had spoken the king, saying, Return to me on the day the third.

en.L: And Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day, as the king had spoken, saying, "Return to me on the third day."
en.B: On the third day Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam, as the king had told them: "Return to me on the third day."
en.R: On the third day Jeroboam and all the people came back to Rehoboam, just as the king had told them to do.

es.L: Y vino Jeroboam con todo el pueblo a Roboam al tercer día, como había hablado el rey, diciendo: «{{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} a mí al tercer día».
es.B: Al tercer día, Jeroboam y todo el pueblo vinieron a Roboam, como el rey les había dicho: «{{plural_you:Vuelvan|Volved}} a verme al tercer día».
es.R: Al tercer día, Jeroboam y todo el pueblo volvieron a ver a Roboam, tal como el rey les había dicho.

fr.L: Et Jéroboam et tout le peuple vinrent vers Roboam le troisième jour, comme le roi l’avait dit en disant : « Revenez vers moi le troisième jour. »
fr.B: Le troisième jour, Jéroboam et tout le peuple vinrent trouver Roboam, comme le roi le leur avait dit : « Revenez me voir le troisième jour. »
fr.R: Le troisième jour, Jéroboam et tout le peuple sont revenus voir Roboam, comme le roi le leur avait demandé.

sw.L: Yeroboamu na watu wote wakaja kwa Rehoboamu siku ya tatu, kama mfalme alivyosema, akisema, "Rudini kwangu siku ya tatu."
sw.B: Siku ya tatu Yeroboamu na watu wote wakaja kwa Rehoboamu, kama mfalme alivyowaambia: "Rudini kwangu siku ya tatu."
sw.R: Siku ya tatu Yeroboamu na watu wote walirudi kwa Rehoboamu, kama mfalme alivyowaambia wafanye.

vi.L: Giê-rô-bô-am và cả dân chúng đến cùng Rô-bô-am vào ngày thứ ba, như vua đã phán bảo rằng: "Hãy trở lại với ta vào ngày thứ ba."
vi.B: Đến ngày thứ ba, Giê-rô-bô-am và cả dân chúng đến gặp Rô-bô-am, như vua đã dặn: "Hãy trở lại gặp ta vào ngày thứ ba."
vi.R: Đến ngày thứ ba, Giê-rô-bô-am và cả dân chúng trở lại gặp Rô-bô-am, đúng như vua đã dặn họ.

ko.L: 그리고 여로보암과 온 백성이 셋째 날에 르호보암에게 왔다. 왕이 "셋째 날에 내게 돌아오너라" 하고 말한 대로였다.
ko.B: 셋째 날에 여로보암과 온 백성이 르호보암에게 왔다. 왕이 "셋째 날에 내게 다시 오너라" 하고 말했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 셋째 날에 여로보암과 온 백성은 왕이 말한 대로 르호보암에게 다시 왔다.

decisions.choice: came: the form marked to be read aloud is singular
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) and the form the scribes marked to be read aloud (qere) spell the verb "came" differently, and the marked form is singular, agreeing with Jeroboam, named first. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: on the third day: the time Rehoboam had set
decisions.reason: The repeated words stress that the people did exactly what the king asked (verse 5). They kept their part; the king's answer follows.

decisions.choice: the king's words are not repeated
decisions.reason: Readable says that the people did as they were told instead of quoting the king again.

source.text: וַיַּ֧עַן הַמֶּ֛לֶךְ אֶת־הָעָ֖ם קָשָׁ֑ה וַֽיַּעֲזֹ֛ב אֶת־עֲצַ֥ת הַזְּקֵנִ֖ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְעָצֻֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And answered the king the people hard, and he abandoned the counsel of the elders which they had counseled him.

en.L: And the king answered the people harshly, and he forsook the counsel of the elders that they had counseled him.
en.B: The king gave the people a harsh answer. He rejected the advice the elders had given him.
en.R: The king answered the people harshly. He did not follow the older men's advice.

es.L: Y el rey respondió al pueblo duramente, y dejó el consejo de los ancianos que le habían aconsejado.
es.B: El rey le dio al pueblo una respuesta dura. Rechazó el consejo que le habían dado los ancianos.
es.R: El rey le respondió al pueblo con dureza. No siguió el consejo de los hombres mayores.

fr.L: Et le roi répondit au peuple durement, et il abandonna le conseil des anciens, qu’ils lui avaient conseillé.
fr.B: Le roi fit au peuple une réponse dure. Il rejeta le conseil que les anciens lui avaient donné.
fr.R: Le roi a répondu durement au peuple. Il n’a pas suivi le conseil des hommes âgés.

sw.L: Mfalme akawajibu watu kwa ukali, akaliacha shauri la wazee walilomshauri.
sw.B: Mfalme akawapa watu jibu kali. Akakataa shauri ambalo wazee walimpa.
sw.R: Mfalme akawajibu watu kwa ukali. Hakufuata ushauri wa wanaume wazee.

vi.L: Vua trả lời dân chúng cách cứng cỏi, và bỏ lời khuyên mà các trưởng lão đã khuyên ông.
vi.B: Vua trả lời dân chúng cách gay gắt. Vua gạt bỏ lời khuyên của các bậc lão thành.
vi.R: Vua trả lời dân chúng cách gay gắt. Vua không theo lời khuyên của những người lớn tuổi.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 백성에게 가혹하게 대답했고, 원로들이 그에게 조언한 조언을 버렸다.
ko.B: 왕은 백성에게 가혹하게 대답했다. 그는 원로들이 해 준 조언을 저버렸다.
ko.R: 왕은 백성에게 거칠게 대답했다. 그는 나이 든 신하들의 조언을 따르지 않았다.

decisions.choice: harshly: the same word as the "hard" service of verse 4
decisions.reason: The people asked to be freed from "hard" service; the king answers them "hard". The repeated word shows that he meets their complaint with more of what they complained of.

decisions.choice: "가혹하게", the word used for the "가혹한 노역" of verse 4
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes that the king answers "hard" to a complaint about "hard" service; Literal and Balanced keep one Korean word in both verses.

source.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֣ר אֲלֵיהֶ֗ם כַּעֲצַ֤ת הַיְלָדִים֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אָבִי֙ הִכְבִּ֣יד אֶֽת־עֻלְּכֶ֔ם וַאֲנִ֖י אֹסִ֣יף עַֽל־עֻלְּכֶ֑ם אָבִ֗י יִסַּ֤ר אֶתְכֶם֙ בַּשּׁוֹטִ֔ים וַאֲנִ֕י אֲיַסֵּ֥ר אֶתְכֶ֖ם בָּעַקְרַבִּֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he spoke to them according to [the] counsel of the young men, saying, My father made heavy your yoke, and I will add to your yoke; my father disciplined you with the whips, and I will discipline you with the scorpions.

en.L: And he spoke to them according to the counsel of the young men, saying, "My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add to your yoke. My father disciplined you with whips, but I will discipline you with scorpions."
en.B: He spoke to them as the young men had advised: "My father made your yoke heavy, but I will make your yoke heavier still. My father punished you with whips, but I will punish you with scorpions."
en.R: He followed the young men's advice and said, "My father put a heavy load on you, but I will make it even heavier. My father punished you with whips, but I will punish you with scorpions, which hurt far more!"

es.L: Y les habló conforme al consejo de los jóvenes, diciendo: «Mi padre hizo pesado {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} yugo, pero yo añadiré a {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} yugo; mi padre {{plural_you:los|os}} castigó con látigos, pero yo {{plural_you:los|os}} castigaré con escorpiones».
es.B: Les habló como le habían aconsejado los jóvenes: «Mi padre {{plural_you:les|os}} impuso un yugo pesado, pero yo lo haré todavía más pesado. Mi padre {{plural_you:los|os}} castigó con látigos, pero yo {{plural_you:los|os}} castigaré con escorpiones».
es.R: Siguió el consejo de los jóvenes y dijo: «Mi padre {{plural_you:les|os}} puso una carga pesada, pero yo la haré todavía más pesada. Mi padre {{plural_you:los|os}} castigó con látigos, ¡pero yo {{plural_you:los|os}} castigaré con escorpiones, que duelen mucho más!».

fr.L: Et il leur parla selon le conseil des jeunes gens, en disant : « Mon père a rendu votre joug pesant, mais moi j’ajouterai à votre joug ; mon père vous a corrigés avec des fouets, mais moi je vous corrigerai avec des scorpions. »
fr.B: Il leur parla comme les jeunes gens le lui avaient conseillé : « Mon père a rendu votre joug pesant, mais moi, je rendrai votre joug plus pesant encore. Mon père vous a punis avec des fouets, mais moi, je vous punirai avec des scorpions. »
fr.R: Il a suivi le conseil des jeunes gens et leur a dit : « Mon père a mis sur vous une lourde charge, mais moi, je la rendrai encore plus lourde. Mon père vous a punis avec des fouets, mais moi, je vous punirai avec des scorpions, qui font bien plus mal ! »

sw.L: Akasema nao kwa kufuata shauri la vijana, akisema, "Baba yangu aliifanya nira yenu kuwa nzito, lakini mimi nitaiongeza nira yenu. Baba yangu aliwaadhibu kwa mijeledi, lakini mimi nitawaadhibu kwa nge."
sw.B: Akasema nao kama vijana walivyomshauri: "Baba yangu aliifanya nira yenu kuwa nzito, lakini mimi nitaifanya nira yenu kuwa nzito zaidi. Baba yangu aliwaadhibu kwa mijeledi, lakini mimi nitawaadhibu kwa nge."
sw.R: Akafuata ushauri wa vijana, akasema, "Baba yangu aliwatwika mzigo mzito, lakini mimi nitauongeza uzito wake. Baba yangu aliwaadhibu kwa mijeledi, lakini mimi nitawaadhibu kwa nge, wanaouma vibaya zaidi!"

vi.L: Ông nói với họ theo lời khuyên của những người trẻ rằng: "Cha ta đã làm cho cái ách của các ngươi nặng, nhưng ta sẽ thêm vào cái ách của các ngươi. Cha ta đã sửa trị các ngươi bằng roi, nhưng ta sẽ sửa trị các ngươi bằng bọ cạp."
vi.B: Vua nói với họ đúng như những người trẻ đã khuyên: "Cha ta đã làm cho ách các ngươi nặng nề, còn ta sẽ làm cho ách các ngươi nặng hơn nữa. Cha ta đã trừng phạt các ngươi bằng roi, còn ta sẽ trừng phạt các ngươi bằng bọ cạp."
vi.R: Vua làm theo lời khuyên của những người trẻ và nói: "Cha ta đã chất gánh nặng lên các ngươi, nhưng ta sẽ làm cho gánh ấy nặng hơn nữa. Cha ta đã trừng phạt các ngươi bằng roi, nhưng ta sẽ trừng phạt các ngươi bằng bọ cạp, còn đau đớn hơn nhiều!"

ko.L: 그리고 그가 젊은이들의 조언대로 그들에게 말했다. "내 아버지는 너희 멍에를 무겁게 했으나, 나는 너희 멍에에 더할 것이다. 내 아버지는 채찍으로 너희를 징계했으나, 나는 전갈로 너희를 징계할 것이다."
ko.B: 그는 젊은이들이 조언한 대로 그들에게 말했다. "내 아버지는 너희 멍에를 무겁게 했지만, 나는 그 멍에를 더 무겁게 하겠다. 내 아버지는 채찍으로 너희를 벌했지만, 나는 전갈로 너희를 벌하겠다."
ko.R: 그는 젊은이들의 조언을 따라 이렇게 말했다. "내 아버지는 너희에게 무거운 짐을 지웠지만, 나는 그 짐을 더 무겁게 하겠다. 내 아버지는 채찍으로 너희를 때렸지만, 나는 전갈로 너희를 때리겠다. 그것은 훨씬 더 아플 것이다!"

decisions.choice: the young men's words repeated almost exactly
decisions.reason: Rehoboam repeats verse 11 nearly word for word. He leaves out the boast about his little finger (verse 10), and he says "made heavy", the people's own word in verse 10, instead of "loaded".

decisions.choice: scorpions: as in verse 11
decisions.reason: As in verse 11, a far crueler punishment than whips.

source.text: וְלֹֽא־שָׁמַ֥ע הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ אֶל־הָעָ֑ם כִּֽי־הָיְתָ֤ה סִבָּה֙ מֵעִ֣ם יְהוָ֔ה לְמַ֜עַן הָקִ֣ים אֶת־דְּבָר֗וֹ אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ בְּיַד֙ אֲחִיָּ֣ה הַשִּׁילֹנִ֔י אֶל־יָרָבְעָ֖ם בֶּן־נְבָֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: And not listened the king to the people, for it was a turn from with Yahweh, in order to establish his word which spoke Yahweh by [the] hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam son of Nebat.

en.L: And the king did not listen to the people, for it was a turn [of events] from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in order to establish {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had spoken by the hand of Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam son of Nebat.
en.B: So the king did not listen to the people, for this turn of events came from {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to fulfill the word {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had spoken through Ahijah the Shilonite to Jeroboam son of Nebat.
en.R: So the king did not listen to the people. This was {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s doing. He was making {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} word come true, the message {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had given to Jeroboam son of Nebat through Ahijah, the prophet from Shiloh.

es.L: Y no escuchó el rey al pueblo, porque era un giro [de los sucesos] de parte {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para cumplir {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había hablado por medio de Ahías el silonita a Jeroboam hijo de Nabat.
es.B: Así que el rey no escuchó al pueblo, porque este giro de los sucesos venía {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para que se cumpliera la palabra que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho a Jeroboam hijo de Nabat por medio de Ahías el silonita.
es.R: Así que el rey no escuchó al pueblo. Esto era obra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Él estaba haciendo que se cumpliera {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} palabra, el mensaje que había dado a Jeroboam hijo de Nabat por medio de Ahías, el profeta de Silo.

fr.L: Et le roi n’écouta pas le peuple, car c’était un tour [des événements] venant {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, afin d’accomplir {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait dite par la main d’Ahiya le Silonite à Jéroboam fils de Nebath.
fr.B: Le roi n’écouta donc pas le peuple, car ce tour des événements venait {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pour accomplir la parole que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait adressée à Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, par Ahiya le Silonite.
fr.R: Le roi n’a donc pas écouté le peuple. C’était l’œuvre {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Il faisait ainsi se réaliser {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} parole, le message qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait donné à Jéroboam, fils de Nebath, par Ahiya, le prophète de Silo.

sw.L: Mfalme hakuwasikiliza watu, kwa maana lilikuwa geuko [la mambo] kutoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili alithibitishe neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilinena kwa mkono wa Ahiya Mshiloni kwa Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati.
sw.B: Basi mfalme hakuwasikiliza watu, kwa maana mageuzi haya ya mambo yalitoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili litimie neno ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alilinena kupitia Ahiya Mshiloni kwa Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati.
sw.R: Basi mfalme hakuwasikiliza watu. Jambo hili lilitoka kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Alikuwa akilitimiza neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, ujumbe aliompa Yeroboamu mwana wa Nebati kupitia Ahiya, nabii wa Shilo.

vi.L: Vua không nghe dân chúng, vì đó là một sự xoay chuyển từ nơi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, để làm ứng nghiệm lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán qua tay A-hi-gia người Si-lô với Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát.
vi.B: Vậy vua không nghe dân chúng, vì sự việc xoay chuyển như thế là do {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, để làm ứng nghiệm lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán với Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát qua A-hi-gia người Si-lô.
vi.R: Vậy vua không nghe lời dân chúng. Đó là việc {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm. Ngài đang làm cho lời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} được thành sự thật, là sứ điệp {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho Giê-rô-bô-am con trai Nê-bát qua A-hi-gia, nhà tiên tri ở Si-lô.

ko.L: 그리고 왕이 백성의 말을 듣지 않았다. 이는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께로부터 [온] 일의 돌이킴이었으니, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 실로 사람 아히야의 손을 통하여 느밧의 아들 여로보암에게 하신 그분의 말씀을 이루시려는 것이었다.
ko.B: 왕은 이렇게 백성의 말을 듣지 않았다. 이 일은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 일으키신 것이었다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 실로 사람 아히야를 통해 느밧의 아들 여로보암에게 하신 말씀을 이루시려는 것이었다.
ko.R: 왕은 백성의 말을 듣지 않았다. 이것은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하신 일이었다. 그분께서는 실로에서 온 예언자 아히야를 통해 느밧의 아들 여로보암에게 주셨던 말씀을 이루고 계셨다.

decisions.choice: a turn of events: something brought about
decisions.reason: The word appears only here and in the parallel, 2 Chronicles 10:15. It comes from the verb "to turn" and means an outcome caused by someone. The Hebrew says it came "from with the LORD": he brought it about.

decisions.choice: Rehoboam's own choice serves the LORD's purpose
decisions.reason: Rehoboam chose his answer himself (verses 8 and 13), yet the writer says the outcome came from the LORD. The LORD had announced that he would tear ten tribes from Solomon's son because of Solomon's idolatry (11:11-13, 31-36).

decisions.choice: Ahijah the Shilonite: the prophet from Shiloh
decisions.reason: Ahijah came from Shiloh, where the tabernacle once stood (1 Samuel 1:3). He tore his new cloak into twelve pieces and gave ten to Jeroboam as a sign (11:29-39).

decisions.choice: by the hand of: through
decisions.reason: God's word comes "by the hand of" a prophet when the prophet speaks it for him.

decisions.choice: the prophet from Shiloh
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the Shilonite" and says that Ahijah was a prophet (11:29).

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, with the article inside the span
decisions.reason: As the Pentateuch note sets for Spanish: el SEÑOR in capitals, Yahvé as the alternative, the article and its contraction (del, al) inside the span. Recorded once for 1 Kings 12-22.

decisions.choice: "Ahías el silonita" (L, B); "Ahías, el profeta de Silo" (R)
decisions.reason: Ahijah has the form used in the Spanish of 1 Samuel 14 (Ahías); Silo is the Samuel note's form.

decisions.choice: "Ahiya le Silonite" (L, B); "Ahiya, le prophète de Silo" (R)
decisions.reason: Ahiya follows the pattern of Abiya in the terms note; Silo is the town’s French name in 1 Samuel.

decisions.choice: neno {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}
decisions.reason: Swahili puts the deity_pronoun span only on free pronouns, here the possessive "lake"; the subject prefixes inside the verbs ("alilinena", "alikuwa") take none, so Swahili has fewer spans than the English.

decisions.choice: "A-hi-gia người Si-lô"
decisions.reason: Ahijah keeps the form used for the other Ahijah in 1 Samuel; Shiloh is "Si-lô", as Psalm 78:60.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun span in Korean
decisions.reason: As the Korean style guide sets out, Korean has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change; respect for God is carried by "-시-", "께서" and "그분" at every level. This holds for the whole block.

source.text: וַיַּ֣רְא כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כִּ֠י לֹֽא־שָׁמַ֣ע הַמֶּלֶךְ֮ אֲלֵיהֶם֒ וַיָּשִׁ֣בוּ הָעָ֣ם אֶת־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ דָּבָ֣ר׀לֵאמֹ֡ר מַה־לָּנוּ֩ חֵ֨לֶק בְּדָוִ֜ד וְלֹֽא־נַחֲלָ֣ה בְּבֶן־יִשַׁ֗י לְאֹהָלֶ֨יךָ֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַתָּ֕ה רְאֵ֥ה בֵיתְךָ֖ דָּוִ֑ד וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְאֹהָלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And saw all Israel that not listened the king to them, and brought back the people [to] the king word, saying, What [is] to us portion in David? And not inheritance in [the] son of Jesse! To your tents, Israel! Now see your house, David! And went Israel to his tents.

en.L: And all Israel saw that the king did not listen to them, and the people returned a word to the king, saying, \q "What portion [is there] for us in David? \q And no inheritance in the son of Jesse! \q To your tents, Israel! Now see to your own house, David!" \q And Israel went to its tents.
en.B: When all Israel saw that the king would not listen to them, the people answered the king: \q "What part do we have in David? \q We have no inheritance in Jesse's son! \q To your tents, Israel! Now look after your own house, David!" \q So Israel went home.
en.R: All Israel saw that the king would not listen to them. So they answered the king, \q "We have no share in David! \q We get nothing from Jesse's son! \q Go home, Israel! David, look after your own family now!" \q So the people of Israel went home.

es.L: Y vio todo Israel que el rey no los escuchaba, y respondió el pueblo al rey, diciendo: \q «¿Qué parte [hay] para nosotros en David? \q ¡Ni heredad en el hijo de Isaí! \q ¡A tus tiendas, Israel! ¡Mira ahora por tu casa, David!». \q Y se fue Israel a sus tiendas.
es.B: Cuando todo Israel vio que el rey no quería escucharlos, el pueblo le respondió al rey: \q «¿Qué parte tenemos nosotros con David? \q ¡No tenemos herencia con el hijo de Isaí! \q ¡A tus tiendas, Israel! ¡Ahora cuida de tu propia casa, David!». \q Así que Israel se fue a casa.
es.R: Todo Israel vio que el rey no quería escucharlos. Así que le respondieron al rey: \q «¡No tenemos nada que ver con David! \q ¡El hijo de Isaí no nos da nada! \q ¡Todos a casa, Israel! ¡David, ahora cuida de tu propia familia!». \q Así que el pueblo de Israel se fue a casa.

fr.L: Et tout Israël vit que le roi ne les écoutait pas, et le peuple répondit une parole au roi en disant : \q « Quelle part [avons-]nous en David ? \q Et pas d’héritage dans le fils de Jessé ! \q À tes tentes, Israël ! Maintenant, veille sur ta maison, David ! » \q Et Israël s’en alla à ses tentes.
fr.B: Quand tout Israël vit que le roi ne voulait pas l’écouter, le peuple répondit au roi : \q « Quelle part avons-nous en David ? \q Nous n’avons pas d’héritage dans le fils de Jessé ! \q À tes tentes, Israël ! Maintenant, occupe-toi de ta maison, David ! » \q Et Israël rentra chez lui.
fr.R: Tout Israël a vu que le roi ne voulait pas l’écouter. Alors les gens ont répondu au roi : \q « Nous n’avons rien à voir avec David ! \q Le fils de Jessé ne nous apporte rien ! \q Rentre chez toi, Israël ! David, occupe-toi de ta famille maintenant ! » \q Et le peuple d’Israël est rentré chez lui.

sw.L: Israeli wote walipoona kwamba mfalme hakuwasikiliza, watu wakamrudishia mfalme neno, wakisema, \q "Tuna fungu gani katika Daudi? \q Wala hatuna urithi katika mwana wa Yese! \q Hemani kwenu, Israeli! Sasa angalia nyumba yako mwenyewe, Daudi!" \q Israeli wakaenda hemani kwao.
sw.B: Israeli wote walipoona kwamba mfalme hatawasikiliza, watu wakamjibu mfalme: \q "Tuna sehemu gani katika Daudi? \q Hatuna urithi katika mwana wa Yese! \q Hemani kwenu, Israeli! Sasa jitunzie nyumba yako mwenyewe, Daudi!" \q Basi Israeli wakaenda nyumbani.
sw.R: Watu wote wa Israeli waliona kwamba mfalme hatawasikiliza. Kwa hiyo wakamjibu mfalme, \q "Hatuna fungu lolote kwa Daudi! \q Hatupati kitu kwa mwana wa Yese! \q Rudini nyumbani, Israeli! Daudi, sasa itunze jamaa yako mwenyewe!" \q Basi watu wa Israeli wakarudi nyumbani.

vi.L: Cả Y-sơ-ra-ên thấy vua không nghe họ, thì dân chúng trả lời vua rằng: \q "Chúng tôi có phần gì nơi Đa-vít? \q Chẳng có cơ nghiệp gì nơi con trai Gie-sê! \q Hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy về trại mình! Hỡi Đa-vít, bây giờ hãy lo lấy nhà mình!" \q Rồi Y-sơ-ra-ên về trại mình.
vi.B: Khi cả Y-sơ-ra-ên thấy vua không chịu nghe mình, dân chúng trả lời vua: \q "Chúng ta có phần gì nơi Đa-vít? \q Chúng ta chẳng có cơ nghiệp nào nơi con trai Gie-sê! \q Hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, hãy về trại mình! Hỡi Đa-vít, giờ hãy tự lo lấy nhà mình!" \q Vậy Y-sơ-ra-ên ai về nhà nấy.
vi.R: Cả Y-sơ-ra-ên thấy vua không chịu nghe họ. Vậy họ trả lời vua: \q "Chúng ta chẳng có phần gì với Đa-vít! \q Con trai Gie-sê chẳng cho chúng ta được gì! \q Hỡi Y-sơ-ra-ên, về nhà thôi! Đa-vít ơi, bây giờ hãy tự lo cho gia đình mình đi!" \q Vậy dân Y-sơ-ra-ên ai về nhà nấy.

ko.L: 그리고 온 이스라엘은 왕이 자기들의 말을 듣지 않는 것을 보았다. 그러자 백성이 왕에게 말을 돌려주어 말했다. \q "우리에게 다윗 안에 무슨 몫이 [있느냐]? \q 이새의 아들에게서 받을 유산도 없다! \q 이스라엘아, 너희 장막으로 [돌아가라]! 다윗아, 이제 네 집이나 돌보아라!" \q 그리고 이스라엘은 자기 장막으로 갔다.
ko.B: 온 이스라엘은 왕이 자기들의 말을 들어주지 않는 것을 보고 왕에게 대답했다. \q "우리가 다윗에게서 받을 몫이 무엇이냐? \q 이새의 아들에게서는 받을 유산이 없다! \q 이스라엘아, 너희 장막으로 돌아가라! 다윗아, 이제 네 집안이나 돌보아라!" \q 그리하여 이스라엘은 저마다 집으로 돌아갔다.
ko.R: 온 이스라엘은 왕이 자기들의 말을 들어주지 않는 것을 보았다. 그래서 그들은 왕에게 대답했다. \q "우리는 다윗과 상관이 없다! \q 이새의 아들에게서 얻을 것이 하나도 없다! \q 이스라엘아, 집으로 돌아가라! 다윗아, 이제 네 집안이나 돌보아라!" \q 그래서 이스라엘 백성은 집으로 돌아갔다.

decisions.choice: the cry of Sheba's revolt against David
decisions.reason: The words echo the cry of Sheba son of Bichri when he led Israel away from David (2 Samuel 20:1). Here the first line is a question ("What portion do we have?") instead of a statement ("We have no portion"), "each man" is missing, and a last line is added: "Now see to your own house, David!" What Sheba began, the northern tribes now finish.

decisions.choice: no portion, no inheritance: David's house is nothing to us
decisions.reason: A portion and an inheritance are a share in family land. The tribes say they have no stake in David's family and owe it nothing.

decisions.choice: to your tents: go home
decisions.reason: The phrase comes from Israel's days of living in tents. It breaks up the assembly: each man goes home, and the people refuse the king (2 Samuel 20:1; 1 Kings 8:66).

decisions.choice: see to your own house, David: let David's family rule its own tribe
decisions.reason: "House" means David's family and line of kings. The tribes tell the house of David to look after Judah, its own tribe, and leave the rest of Israel alone.

decisions.choice: the son of Jesse: said with contempt
decisions.reason: Calling David "the son of Jesse" instead of by his name or title is a slight, as in 1 Samuel 20:27 and 22:7-9 and 2 Samuel 20:1.

decisions.choice: the cry set in three lines
decisions.reason: The people's answer is a short poem; its lines follow the Hebrew divisions, with the last two calls sharing a line. Literal and Balanced keep the wording of 2 Samuel 20:1 where the Hebrew is the same ("portion", "part", "inheritance", "Jesse's son"); the narrative closing the verse stands as its own line.

decisions.choice: We have no share; We get nothing; Go home; family
decisions.reason: Readable turns the question into a plain statement, as in 2 Samuel 20:1, and explains "to your tents" and "house".

decisions.choice: "parte", "heredad" / "herencia", "a tus tiendas" (L, B); "¡Todos a casa, Israel!" (R)
decisions.reason: The cry is the one Sheba raised in 2 Samuel 20:1, so each level keeps the Spanish wording of that verse where the Hebrew is the same.

decisions.choice: "Nous n’avons rien à voir avec David"; "Rentre chez toi"; "ta famille" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable, the question becomes a statement and "to your tents" and "house" are put in plain words.

decisions.choice: fungu ... urithi; Hatuna fungu lolote kwa Daudi! Hatupati kitu kwa mwana wa Yese!
decisions.reason: The cry repeats Sheba's in 2 Samuel 20:1, so Swahili keeps the words used there ("fungu", "urithi", Readable "Hatuna fungu lolote kwa Daudi! Hatupati kitu kwa mwana wa Yese!").

decisions.choice: "chúng ta" (B, R) in the cry
decisions.reason: At Balanced and Readable the cry is the people calling to one another to leave, so it says "chúng ta", including the hearers; Literal keeps "chúng tôi", addressed to the king.

decisions.choice: the cry in 해라체, with no word of address to the king
decisions.reason: The people who petitioned the king in 합쇼체 now throw off his rule; plain 해라체 and "다윗아" carry the contempt the meaning decisions note in "the son of Jesse".

decisions.choice: the cry worded as Sheba's cry in the Korean 2 Samuel 20:1
decisions.reason: The meaning decision notes that Israel repeats Sheba's cry; Korean keeps "몫", "이새의 아들에게서 받을 유산" and "장막으로 돌아가라" from that verse so the echo is heard.

source.text: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל הַיֹּשְׁבִ֖ים בְּעָרֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֑ה וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם רְחַבְעָֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sons of Israel, the ones dwelling in [the] cities of Judah, reigned over them Rehoboam.

en.L: But [as for] the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel who were living in the cities of Judah, Rehoboam reigned over them.
en.B: But Rehoboam reigned over the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} who lived in the towns of Judah.
en.R: But Rehoboam still ruled over the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} who lived in the towns of Judah.

es.L: Pero [en cuanto a] los hijos de Israel que habitaban en las ciudades de Judá, Roboam reinó sobre ellos.
es.B: Pero Roboam reinó sobre los israelitas que vivían en las ciudades de Judá.
es.R: Pero Roboam siguió gobernando a los israelitas que vivían en las ciudades de Judá.

fr.L: Mais [quant aux] {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël qui habitaient dans les villes de Juda, Roboam régna sur eux.
fr.B: Mais Roboam régna sur les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} qui habitaient les villes de Juda.
fr.R: Mais Roboam régnait toujours sur les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} qui habitaient dans les villes de Juda.

sw.L: Lakini wana wa Israeli waliokuwa wakikaa katika miji ya Yuda, Rehoboamu akatawala juu yao.
sw.B: Lakini Rehoboamu akatawala juu ya Waisraeli waliokaa katika miji ya Yuda.
sw.R: Lakini Rehoboamu bado aliwatawala Waisraeli waliokaa katika miji ya Yuda.

vi.L: Còn con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên sống trong các thành của Giu-đa thì Rô-bô-am cai trị trên họ.
vi.B: Nhưng Rô-bô-am cai trị dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sống trong các thành của Giu-đa.
vi.R: Nhưng Rô-bô-am vẫn cai trị dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sống trong các thành của Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그러나 유다 성읍들에 사는 이스라엘 자손으로 말하면, 르호보암이 그들 위에 왕이 되었다.
ko.B: 그러나 유다 성읍들에 사는 이스라엘 자손은 르호보암이 다스렸다.
